name: get_testflight_crash_log
title: Get a TestFlight crash log
description: A crash feedback's crash log, saved whole to the server's outbox: the answer gives the file's path, SHA-256 and size, and its first 40 lines.

submission.description: A crash feedback's id, from list_testflight_feedback.

name: health
title: Health
description: Whether each store's credentials work, and what they reach: the apps the App Store Connect key sees (their bundle ids and Apple ids), and each Play package this server answers for, with one review read. A store without credentials is reported as not configured.

name: list_app_store_reviews
title: List App Store reviews
description: An app's App Store reviews, newest first unless sorted otherwise: rating, title, text, the reviewer's nickname, the storefront, the date, and the developer's reply with its state (pending until Apple publishes it). Filter by star rating, storefront or whether it has a reply.

app.description: The app: its bundle id ("com.example.app") or its Apple id (digits). Leave it out when the key sees one app (health lists them).

territory.description: Only reviews from this storefront: Apple's three-letter code, e.g. USA, ROU, GBR.

replied.description: true: only reviews with a published reply; false: only those without one.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to read on.

name: list_play_reviews
title: List Google Play reviews
description: A package's Google Play reviews with text, newest first: rating, text, author, language, app version, device, the date, and the developer's reply. Google's API returns only reviews written or changed in the last 7 days; older ones are in Play Console's reports.

package.description: The Play package, e.g. "com.example.app". Leave it out when the server answers for one (health lists them).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to read on.

translate_to.description: Have Google translate each review into this language, e.g. "en".

name: list_testflight_feedback
title: List TestFlight feedback
description: What testers sent from the TestFlight app, newest first: screenshot feedback (comment and screenshots, at URLs that expire) and crash feedback (comment; get_testflight_crash_log reads the log), each with the tester's e-mail, device, OS and the build number.

app.description: The app: its bundle id ("com.example.app") or its Apple id (digits). Leave it out when the key sees one app (health lists them).

kind.description: Only crash feedback or only screenshot feedback. Default: both, merged newest first (page through one kind with its cursor).

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call of the same kind.

name: reply_app_store_review
title: Reply to an App Store review
description: Publish a reply under an App Store review, in the developer's name and visible to everyone once Apple publishes it: send only text the user approved for this review. A review that already has a different reply is refused unless replace is true; the same text again sends nothing.

replace.description: Put this reply in place of the review's existing one. Without it, a review that already has a different reply is refused.

name: reply_play_review
title: Reply to a Google Play review
description: Publish a reply under a Google Play review, in the developer's name and visible to everyone: send only text the user approved for this review. A review that already has a different reply is refused unless replace is true; the same text again sends nothing.

package.description: The Play package, e.g. "com.example.app". Leave it out when the server answers for one (health lists them).

text.description: The reply, at most 350 characters (Google's limit).

replace.description: Put this reply in place of the review's existing one. Without it, a review that already has a different reply is refused.
